## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — confirmatory signals: weak sector breadth and major divergence across large caps (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leads: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%). Healthcare and Real Estate are the other positive sectors on the week.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Communication weak: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%), CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -13.95% | 1M: -16.52%). Energy and Financials also under pressure on the 1W snapshot.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%), ETN ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.75% | 1M: +4.85%), LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%). Leadership concentrated and narrow: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -13.95% | 1M: -16.52%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -15.96%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.46%). Weakness concentrated in Communication and select defensives.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +25.30%), AMD (1W: +24.75%), META (1W: +11.45%), ETN (1W: +10.75%), LRCX (1W: +10.53%). Major divergence flagged — several large caps (LRCX, AMAT, ASML, CRM, MSFT) show 1W ≠ 1M, so treat moves as tactical until breadth confirms.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech is the clear epicenter of strength but leadership is narrow; NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +8.89%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +4.25%). Sector positive on the week but watch trend-exhaustion signals.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are mixed/soft on the week; JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +0.14%) while MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.08%) and V showing CORRECTION dynamics (1W: -1.42% | 1M: +1.15%). Sector not among the three weekly positives — watch credit/cycle headlines.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare is one of the few positive sectors; JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +1.28%), LLY RECOVERY (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -6.39%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.29%). Mixed internals but bullish news flows are supporting select names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Maintain neutral positioning; favor selective exposure to high-conviction tech winners (INTC, AMD, META) while reducing exposure to weak communication names (NFLX, TMUS) and select cyclicals showing deterioration. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but with caution due to narrow leadership and pronounced divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%).  
BEARISH: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%), UPS BELOW TREND (1W: -7.52% | 1M: -7.63%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (primary momentum source), Healthcare (selective catalyst-driven names).  
BEARISH: Communication (broad weakness), Energy (weak week), Financials (flat-to-soft).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch follow-through above this week’s tech highs for confirmation of the recent rally in INTC/AMD/META and any reversal back below intraday support for LRCX/AMAT/ASML as signals of trend failure; monitor MSFT sentiment/upgrade flow for confirmation of its CORRECTION resolving. Track headline risk in Communication names (subscriber/newsflow) and earnings/sentiment catalysts in Healthcare.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MSFT (+50): Analyst upgrade and AI growth commentary; price in CORRECTION (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +4.25%) — sentiment is supportive but price shows short-term exhaustion. (Other big bullish headlines include AVGO +70 and AMGN +80 in the news feed; cross-check price action before adding exposure.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NFLX (-50): HSBC downgrade cited; price BELOW TREND (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%) — sentiment confirming weakness. TMUS (-50): JPM cut target; price BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) — headline-driven selling confirmed. UPS (-50): cut target on volumes; price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.52% | 1M: -7.63%) — sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive and leadership Narrow (4/5 Technology). INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (LRCX, AMAT, ASML, CRM, MSFT) and weak overall breadth — monitor sentiment-driven confirmation (e.g., MSFT +50) before adding conviction.
